nodes.label: showcase-strategy.md
nodes.rationale: Decides which project fills «شرح المفاهيم», in what form, and which recordings exist per section and day. Reversed 2026-09-25; the old arrangement survives only as the appendix.

nodes.label: 2026-09-25 reversal: darrisni records, BookIt out
nodes.rationale: The 2026-09-22 split (BookIt showcases, darrisni goes live) is dead. A finished project cannot demonstrate a process: BookIt can only show a conversation that already happened, and a trainee watching a replay of someone else's finished thinking has nothing to copy. darrisni is built on the trainee's own stack (same PRODUCT.md, notebook.txt, skills) so every recording is something the trainee will literally repeat.

nodes.label: darrisni (tutor-student project, trainee-test)
nodes.rationale: C:\Users\ammar\future-dev\claude\trainee-test; tutor<->student; first named on day-03.html:705. Every recording in the course is made on it.

nodes.label: BookIt (trainer's booking-system project)
nodes.rationale: The trainer's finished project; no BookIt screenshots or recordings exist; its deployment is down (Render free tier expired).

nodes.label: «شرح المفاهيم» session (showcase)

nodes.rationale: The trainer re-runs the same steps live. Named «تطبيق مع المدرب» elsewhere in the skill.

nodes.label: Open item: no project for the live session
nodes.rationale: darrisni is spent on recordings so it cannot also be the live project; the live session needs a project whose next step is genuinely unperformed. Not chosen yet; do not plan around it as if solved.

nodes.label: Interleaved per section: explain, play, re-run
nodes.rationale: explain §A -> play §A's recording -> trainer re-runs §A live -> explain §B... Not two blocks, which is why days 2-10 have no «تطبيق مع المدرب» break slide.

nodes.rationale: The deck references recordings by name (see MEDIA_SHOTLIST). '8.1_&_8.2_tasks.mp4' was renamed because & must be escaped in an HTML attribute and no other asset uses underscores.

nodes.rationale: Dropped 2026-09-29: reviewing written requirements turned out to be a plain read/note/feedback loop with nothing demo-worthy, so its placeholder slide was deleted rather than left as --soon.

nodes.label: A take can outrun its brief and be right
nodes.rationale: task-10.1.mp4 violated its capture brief's 'must not show the formal requirement being written (that is Day 4)', but the brief was stale: the 2026-09-28 rebalance moved the formats block and 10.2 to Day 3. When footage contradicts a shotlist entry, re-read the curriculum before assuming the footage is wrong.

nodes.label: Recorded beats need honest outcomes
nodes.rationale: The shot list demanded 'the first test run must genuinely fail' and planned a stepvid__step--new row for it. The real unscripted second session (a plain request in Antigravity) triggered correctly first try, so slide 16 was rebuilt to match the footage and the failure row removed. A recorded 'it broke' needs real breakage; a recorded 'it worked' needs an honestly unscripted test.

nodes.label: §7.11 recording teaches a method, not a task
nodes.rationale: The demoed skill («جولة قبل العرض») is one menu option among eight; the recording proves the six-slot method works end to end. Do not generalise this exception without checking the 'one method, many valid instances' shape applies.

nodes.label: Day 5 split at the tool boundary
nodes.rationale: §12 crosses two tools (Claude Code writes prompts, Claude Design builds and generates), so the curriculum's single 46 د تطبيق row was split into 18 + 28 د to give each its own recording and slide.

nodes.label: §12, §13, §14.3-14.5 are not one-time
nodes.rationale: Default interleaved treatment, no «يُشاهَد ولا يُعاد تنفيذه» note. Run the test explicitly rather than inheriting from the previous day: a second live run on a different project gives a different, informative result every time.

nodes.label: §13.1 mirrors §12.1 extract-then-verify
nodes.rationale: Entities are derivable from roles, requirements, journey and screens already on record by Day 6. A same-day review before filming moved the boundary: 13.1 is everything Claude produces in one continuous pass, 13.2 is the trainee's review alone.

nodes.label: Label a defective-clip beat, don't re-cut
nodes.rationale: task_14.4.mp4 is the only Day 1-7 clip whose first half shows behaviour the trainee must not copy. The fix is four stepvid__fix amber notes naming each beat: the recovery is itself the lesson, since rejecting output that doesn't match their design is the review behaviour §14 asks for.

Until then 'open a forbidden page' returns 404 (not built), indistinguishable through a UI-only review from 403 (not allowed). task_14.4.mp4 ends at 4:32-4:33 on /book/confirm returning 404.

nodes.label: Choose the form per content type
nodes.rationale: Task the trainee performs -> recording on darrisni (default); diagram -> show the diagram (drawio files are presentable as-is); thinking artifact -> recording of the conversation (8.1/8.2 proved this films fine); finished app -> one tour recorded once.

nodes.label: The chatlog component is dead
nodes.rationale: Built for BookIt conversation replays; its last instance (Day-2 slide 14) was replaced by tasks-91-92.mp4 on 2026-09-25, so no deck uses it. CSS and JS stay in deck.css/deck.js deliberately. Do not author new chatlog slides; a recording teaches more.

nodes.label: Trainer-example discipline (CLAUDE.md A.5)
nodes.rationale: Product only (exclude anything about building this course); drop trainer-stack specifics (mostly moot on darrisni); when unsure, ask.

nodes.label: BookIt examples need framing
nodes.rationale: BookIt examples are allowed; unframed ones are not. Every recording is on darrisni, so a trainee meeting «مقدّم الخدمة» or «شبكة الخدمات» cold tries to map it onto darrisni, fails, and reads the slide as assuming knowledge never given. Pick the disposition by asking whether the lesson needs the domain.

nodes.label: 2026-10-08 audit: six BookIt sites
nodes.rationale: A 2026-09-25 note claimed 'no BookIt material survives in any deck'; it was wrong and unchecked for two weeks. A full audit found six BookIt-vocabulary sites across days 1, 2, 6, 7, 8. Do not trust a blanket 'it's all gone' claim; grep for the nouns.

nodes.label: day-08 slide 7 opened «في المهمة 14.3»
nodes.rationale: The worst unframed case: it reads as the task the trainee did yesterday on their own project.

nodes.label: Disposition: frame it
nodes.rationale: Use when the incident IS the domain (e.g. a provider could book their own slot). Open with «في مشروع سابق للمدرب — نظام حجز مواعيد، مو اللي في المقاطع», then use the nouns freely. Put it in the slide's lead so the cards inherit it; drop into the card only when the lead is occupied.

nodes.label: Disposition: genericise it
nodes.rationale: Use when the lesson is domain-free and understanding the example costs two or three prerequisite facts: strip the nouns. The «لماذا لا…؟» filter story became «تصفية بحسب من يقدّمها», same lesson with zero prerequisites.

nodes.label: Frame at earliest occurrence, call back later
nodes.rationale: Later tellings say «وهذا نفس المثال اللي شفته في اليوم الثاني». The provider-self-booking incident runs on days 2, 7, 8; the filter question on days 7 and 8.

nodes.label: day-02.html:793 is the model framing
nodes.rationale: «في مشروع حجز مواعيد صار العكس»: the domain stated inline beside an explicitly darrisni card so the contrast is visible. It was right from the start.

nodes.label: Mirror rule for .claude/skills
nodes.rationale: A skill telling Claude to relay an example to the trainee carries the same framing obligation: building-features/SKILL.md held the identical unframed filter story. Claude-facing 'watch for this' notes never quoted onward (defining-users, testing-and-security, writing-requirements) are out of scope and keep booking nouns deliberately.

nodes.label: Pre-ship grep for booking nouns
nodes.rationale: Before shipping any day grep the deck for مقدّم الخدمة / شبكة الخدمات / التوفّر / مواعيد الخدمات / رابط الاجتماع and read every hit in place; each must sit within two lines of a framing clause or be genericised.

nodes.label: Step must match the delivered cut, not the session
nodes.rationale: The real 8.1/8.2 session had a correction round that the trainer edited out of tasks-81-82.mp4 on purpose. A step authored from the written log (conversation_history.md / PRODUCT.md) can describe something true of the session but not visible in the shipped video: check frames at the step's own timestamp.

nodes.label: Stale wording in a clip: stepvid__fix note
nodes.rationale: A recording can show wording the deck has since moved past; say so in a stepvid__fix note rather than re-recording. No current step needs one; kept as the pattern.

nodes.label: §14 clone-and-replay question: moot
nodes.rationale: The old plan deferred to Day 6 whether §14 gets an incremental BookIt clone-and-replay. Dropped: the killing objection was the stack (Maven, two-server local setup, native Postgres, none of which a trainee runs). States §14 will be recorded 'on the live-session project like every other section', wording that predates the reversal.

nodes.label: A correction can be as unverified as the bug
nodes.rationale: deployment.mp4's first review pass (2026-09-26) came from an auto-generated step-by-step with no frame extracted: it mis-attributed a human-typed CLI install to Claude and flagged root directory and production keys as unconfirmed though both are evidenced on screen (a live login on the deployed URL greeting the trainer by email needs a working DB connection). Re-corrected against extracted frames before slide 9 was time-stamped.
